# Extract the numeric part of the score column (the total after '=')
df['total_score'] = df['score'].str.extract(r'= (\d+)').astype(int)

# Find the minimum total score
min_score = df['total_score'].min()

# Check if Steve Stricker from United States has that minimum score
answer = ((df['player'] == 'steve stricker') & (df['country'] == 'united states') & (df['total_score'] == min_score)).any()

# Clean up the temporary column
df.drop(columns=['total_score'], inplace=True)
